results.actual_output: The mother demands payment and the daughter refuses for lack of money. Neither adds leverage. “Must pay / how can you refuse / have to come up with it” repeats the same demand at the same intensity; “no money / really no money” repeats the same refusal. Information, strategy, and consequences do not change. This is circular dialogue. The request is diagnosis only, so no rewritten draft is supplied.

The three denials repeat words but change function: an immediate denial, fear under the pressure of the bloodstained backpack, then an appeal for the mother’s trust after withdrawing from her touch. Preserve that three-step progression; adjust pauses and action only as needed, rather than collapsing it into one denial.
This is whole-series restructuring and episode-hook design, outside em-dialogue’s scope. Route to structure or adaptation work. A specific dialogue excerpt can be reviewed separately.
